title: Fit a Voronoi map inside a non-convex or multipart region — vmap_region
text: weights Finite positive numeric weights, one per cell. region two-column coordinate matrix; ring list(x = ..., y = ...); list matrices rings; sf/sfc polygon object. Matrix ring coordinates treated planar. Rings use even-odd fill rule: ring inside another ring hole, regardless orientation. Repeated closing vertices optional. sf, features united one region; use separate calls fit districts independently. labels Optional unique cell labels, otherwise V1, V2, etc. crs Optional projected coordinate system passed sf::st_transform() sf/sfc input. Geographic longitude/latitude input must projected explicitly. place-name lookup automatic projection performed. seed Optional integer seed. supplied, caller's random-number state restored computation. max_iter Maximum number iterations; default 1000. convergence_ratio Stop sum absolute cell-area errors, divided region area, value; default 0.005. min_weight_ratio Minimum weight fraction largest weight. Default 0 preserves requested proportions. Positive values inflate small weights change targets. verbose Print progress every 25 iterations?

title: Fit a Voronoi map inside a non-convex or multipart region — vmap_region

Coordinates use output planar units; areas use squares. vm_as_df() adds ring column, mapped subgroup rule = "evenodd" plotting.

title: Fit a Voronoi map inside a non-convex or multipart region — vmap_region
text: Computation uses translated, uniformly scaled coordinates avoid instability large map coordinates. Output coordinates areas restored input (requested projected) coordinate system. Boundaries simplified automatically. Invalid sf geometry rejected; repair explicitly calling. Coordinate rings interpreted even-odd rule normalized polyclip. Cells may contain several disconnected pieces holes. successful area fit imply geographically meaningful cell positions. Convergence guaranteed every shape weight distribution: unsuccessful fit emits warning returns best layout found converged = FALSE. Never use unchecked layout exact encoding. 100 position/weight iterations, stalled fit uses remaining iteration budget fixed-site, coordinate-wise weight searches. power weights may negative; data weights remain positive. Supports ggvmap(), autoplot(), plot(), vm_as_df(), vm_centroids(), ordinary cell annotations. Hierarchical grouping implemented; fit separate regions separately. Interactive rendering decorative outer ring currently unavailable region maps.
